note: Alternative chemical names for monomers whose own name does not contain the word a chemist searches by. Selected from PubChem's synonym list for the compound whose InChIKey matches the fragment this project SHIPS, so an alias belongs to our molecule rather than to a similar name.
why: The table mixes two naming conventions: the vendored rows carry trivial names, the rows added here carry PubChem IUPAC. So 3-mercaptopropionic acid is filed as '3-sulfanylpropanoic acid', and a real run searched for a 3-mercaptopropionyl, found nothing, and reported that the vocabulary had no such monomer. It has two.
selection: Per monomer, a greedy cover of the synonyms contributing the most words the monomer's own name lacks, capped at 4. Shortest-first was tried and is wrong: it prefers `2hmb` and `C16:0` to `Mercaptopropionic acid`. Registry numbers, all-caps codes, grade and method words are dropped, and a synonym must contain chemical morphology to be considered.
